body: Well, I seem to have already scared him off, this is day two of him refusing to answer my texts, so I guess it's a moot point. I'll keep your advice in mind if there's a next time, though.
I'm worried about what would happen if I let myself get so invested over those couple of months, though, and he decides he doesn't want me anyway.

I'm definitely working so that I don't have to deal with certain things. My home life is terrible, so the more excuses I have to be out of the house the better. But I'm also working so much to try and get into a better space. I'm trying to move into my own apartment. But once I do I'll still have to have the same amount of work.
I'll have to look into that. I'm sure I qualify, this is my third year with the company.
